# AI MockTest 🎯

**Create, take, and dissect mock tests — generated by AI.** An end-to-end exam practice platform for objective-style tests (JEE-pattern friendly).

## Features

- 🤖 **Create a Mock Test with AI** — describe what you want; the app parses it into a structured test
- 🧩 **Full question taxonomy** — SCQ, MCQ, Numerical, and Subjective questions, organized into sections & topics
- 📝 **Serious test-taking engine**
  - NTA-style question states: *not visited / visited / unanswered / answered / marked / answered & marked*
  - Per-question time tracking
  - Timed tests with question palette navigation
- 📊 **Analysis** — accuracy, time spent, charts, and weak-topic review after every attempt
- 🔁 **Practice mode** — drill questions outside full tests
- 📈 **State persisted** locally (zustand + persist) so attempts survive reloads

## Tech stack

- React + TypeScript + Vite, React Router
- Zustand (persistent store), KaTeX for math rendering, Recharts-style analysis charts
- Google GenAI SDK for test generation

## Running locally

```bash
npm install
# set GEMINI_API_KEY in .env.local
npm run dev
```
